_doc: The form of tests/hil/boards.local.json (git ignores the local file). Copy this file to it and put in your boards.
manager: the URL of the manager (else --manager, TFN_MANAGER or the store setup).
deny_ports: the ports that the tool never opens (for example a port of another USB device or of a board of a user).
boards: name (as in the manager), port (the console port; none for a board with no USB), mac (12 hex digits:
the USB serial number of the port must be this MAC), kind (lcd349, cores3, am175, am18, watcher, tab5),
role: console (mem + open-all), pair (one of the two boards of the link test), net (versions only).
Optional: min_internal (the limit of the mem check in bytes), web_password (a board with a web password).
